answer: The grading quorum of 3 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The whisper assignment is published and cedar records each panel. Shards are assigned from the glacier graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 1004 identities would post 3026 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
